habit-tracker.tailor: Ask which habits fit that and how often, then set up my tracker.

fits.why: Tick each habit off every day and see your streaks.
Make it a habit you tick every day, with a streak.

meeting-notes.tailor: Ask what these meetings are and who is in them, then set the note up for them.

fits.why: After each meeting: what was decided, and who does what.

daily-standup.tailor: Ask what I'm working on and who reads it, then write today's standup.

fits.why: Yesterday, today and what's in the way, one section a day.

meal-plan.tailor: Ask who I cook for and what to skip, then plan the dinners and the grocery list.

fits.why: Plans the week's dinners and writes the shopping list.

reading-list.tailor: Ask what I like to read and what's on my list, then file the first books.

fits.why: Books to read, reading and finished, each with a line on why.

mood-energy-log.tailor: Ask what I want to notice, then log today.

fits.why: A short evening check-in that shows patterns over weeks.

job-hunt.tailor: Ask what kind of job I'm looking for and where I've applied, then fill in the table.

fits.why: Every application, where it stands and what happens next.
Every application, where it stands and what happens next.

trip-plan.tailor: Ask when I'm going, who with and what I enjoy, then plan the trip.

fits.why: The days, the bookings and a packing list, with a countdown.
Plans the trip day by day, with bookings and a packing list.

study-flashcards.tailor: Ask what I'm studying and for my notes, then make the first cards.

fits.why: Turns your notes into flashcards that come back when due.

decision-log.tailor: Ask what's being decided and what the options are, then log it.

fits.why: What you chose, what you didn't, and why.
What you chose, what you didn't, and why.

workout-log.tailor: Ask what I train and how often, then set the log up for that.

fits.why: A row for each session, and your personal bests.
A row for each run, with distance and time, and your bests.

budget-log.tailor: Ask what I can spend a month and on what, then set up my budget.

fits.why: What you spend against a monthly budget, by category.

one-on-one-notes.tailor: Ask who it's with and what I want to raise, then add it under Next time.

fits.why: One running note per person: topics, then follow-ups.

book-notes.tailor: Ask which book and what stood out so far, then start its notes.

fits.why: The big idea and the best lines of each book you read.

bug-triage.tailor: Ask what product it's for and for the first report, then file it.

fits.why: Every bug in one table, sorted by severity.

weekly-review.tailor: Ask what a good week looks like for me, then run this week's review.

fits.why: Five questions once a week, written up for you.

recipe-box.tailor: Ask what I like to cook and for the first recipe, then file it.

fits.why: Each recipe cleaned up and filed, ingredients as a checklist.

content-calendar.tailor: Ask where I post and how often, then plan the next two weeks.

fits.why: What goes out when, and a list of ideas for later.

home-maintenance.tailor: Ask what kind of home I have and what needs doing, then add the jobs.

fits.why: What's due around the house, and when you last did it.

gift-ideas.tailor: Ask who I buy for and what they like, then add the first ideas.

fits.why: Ideas by person, saved when you hear them.

cornell-notes.tailor: Ask what course it's for and for my notes, then make Cornell notes.

fits.why: Lecture notes with a question for each and a summary.

daily-journal.tailor: Ask what I want to remember each day, then write today's entry.

fits.why: Four short questions a day, written up as an entry.

grocery-list.tailor: Ask what I need and where I shop, then add it sorted by aisle.

fits.why: One shopping list, sorted by aisle.
